{{Top|leg}}
'''Kulai''' was the title used by [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] in [[Kriek]] society. They were wanderers, choosing to live outside society in exchange for greater communion with the [[Deity/Legends|gods]]. They served as [[Advisor/Legends|advisors]] to the Kriek tribes, and were respected and slightly feared by their fellow Kriek. [[Malketh]] was a kulai who advised the [[Kherkhaman]] tribe.<ref name="Scout">{{JournalCite|13|Scouts' Dispatch}}</ref>
